body:
I reproduced this with the `pushall` payload from your diagnostic against the 2.2.25 code: slot 0 comes out `state 0` (genuinely empty, its MQTT entry is just `{"id": "0"}`), slots 1 to 3 stay at the default `state 8` and get reset to Empty even though `tray_type`/`tray_info_idx`/`tray_color` are populated. Your firmware never sends a per-tray `state`, so the check added in #2023 had nothing to go on.

This is already fixed on `main` by #2105 (commit 088e8bb), which falls back to the filament metadata when `state` has never been reported. Same payload against current main gives slot 0 Empty and slots 1 to 3 Generic PLA with the right colours. That fix shipped in v2.2.26-beta5 on Sep 6 and is not in a stable release yet, which is why 2.2.25 still shows it. If you can try the beta it should confirm.
Can you please test with v2.2.26?
Correction to my earlier note: v2.2.26 went stable on Sep 12 and includes #2105 (commit 088e8bb), so updating to 2.2.26 as Adrian suggests should resolve this. Nothing further needed from my side.
